item.message: Code Mode is unavailable because code-mode host is disabled. Code mode will fail closed; enable `features.code_mode_host` and install `codex-code-mode-host`.

item.text: {"rule":"The procedure adaptively treated each tap as either keep or discard so that the ace of spades always survived: a tapped pair containing it remained, while a tapped pair without it was discarded; at the final step, tapping the ace of spades kept it, while tapping the other card discarded that card."}
